summary.plain: A tank of gadolinium-loaded liquid scintillator split into six identical cells in a row, read out by photomultipliers, which sat next to the reactor under heavy shielding.
summary.technical: Acrylic target aquarium (2.233 m x 0.889 m x 1.230 m) divided longitudinally into six identical optically separated cells filled with Gd-loaded liquid scintillator, surrounded by a gamma catcher, veto and passive shielding; PMT readout with pulse-shape discrimination.

technology.quote: It is longitudinally divided in six identical and optically separated cells.
technology.value: Six-cell Gd-loaded liquid-scintillator antineutrino detector with PMT readout
